title: Removed omniroute from HolyCode repo
body:
Omniroute (free AI gateway) was split out to a separate container for durability/setup reasons. Removed all references from the HolyCode repo:

- Dockerfile: removed `npm i -g omniroute` install block and the s6-overlay omniroute service block (COPY type/run, chmod, contents.d registration).
- config/opencode.json: removed the `provider.omniroute` block (baseURL 127.0.0.1:17321, sleeve-base-url 127.0.0.1:20128/v1). JSON re-validated.
- Deleted s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/omniroute/ (run, type).
- Deleted config/agents/omniroute-auto.md.
- README.md: removed intro mentions, provider table row, dedicated OmniRoute paragraph, two compose port mappings (20128:20128), AI-tools table row, mermaid node K[OmniRoute :20128] + dangling K->R edge, `omniroute status` command row, and the "OmniRoute not responding" troubleshooting details block.

Verification: case-insensitive grep across repo (excluding .git) for "omniroute", port "20128", and "sleeve-base-url"/"sleeve-harness" all return zero matches. docker-compose files were already free of omniroute references. Git status shows 3 deletions and 3 modifications.
